modes.title: Story Starters
modes.skill: telling a beginning, middle, and ending

beats.line: Once upon a time, two friends found tiny footprints in the forest. Who made them?
Then they heard a little cry across the stream. Show how the friends helped.
At last, everyone was safe. How does your forest story end?
Once upon a time, two friends found a glowing map to the moon.
Then a little star needed their help. What did the friends do?
At last, the moon began to sparkle. How does your space story end?
Once upon a time, two friends prepared a royal picnic.
Then a gust of wind sent everything flying. Show what happened next.
At last, everyone helped. How does your picnic story end?
The three little pigs each built a house. Show what they used.
Then the wolf huffed and puffed. What happened to the houses?
The brick house stayed strong. How does your pig story end?
Goldilocks found a little cottage in the woods. Who lived there?
She tried the porridge, chairs, and beds. Show what happened.
Then the bear family came home. How does your gentle Goldilocks story end?
Little Red carried a basket through the woods to Grandma's house.
Then she met a tricky wolf on the path. What did she do?
At last, Little Red reached Grandma safely. How does your story end?

voice.intro: Welcome to Puppet Retell! Pick a story, dress your puppets, and make a show with your own voice.
voice.guided: Story Starters. Pick a picture, then tell the beginning, middle, and ending.
voice.free: Free Show. Pick your puppets and make up any story you like.
voice.shows: My Shows. Your stories stay right here on this tablet.
voice.pickStory: Pick a story to act out.
voice.pickStage: Choose a stage and add something fun to wear or hold.
voice.ready: Your stage is ready. Tap the red circle when you are ready to tell your story.
voice.micOkay: Your voice stays on this tablet.
voice.micNo: The microphone is resting. Your puppet moves will still be saved.
voice.nextBeat: Wonderful. Here comes the next part.
voice.saved: Your puppet show is saved on this tablet!
voice.shelfFull: Your show shelf is full. Erase one old show before saving another.
